title: Philadelphia Experiment as cover for nuclear accident

tellings.quote: A turbine exploded, and the men got showered with hexafluoride, something a fluid that had been radiated.

related.note: Both explain what the Philadelphia Experiment really covered up. Greer says it was a cover for something done in Rhode Island; this telling says it hid a turbine explosion that showered the crew with radioactive hexafluoride.

plain: The Philadelphia Experiment is a story about a 1943 US Navy test on a warship. A researcher named Jan Lundquist, in a documentary by the podcast host Jesse Michels about the scientist Townsend Brown, says the story was really a cover for an accident, tied to Philadelphia and Norfolk, Virginia. According to Lundquist, a turbine exploded and the men were showered with hexafluoride, a fluid that had been made radioactive, which would mean the famous tale was invented to hide a nuclear mishap.
